title: L7 Edge Proxy Ingestion Panic (TryFromSliceError)
root_cause: system.columns multi-shard reflection expanded dynamic catalog to 280 features

updates.message: Critical panic detected: L7 Edge Proxy Ingestion Panic (TryFromSliceError). Edge proxy non-responsive.
Identified cross-boundary schema drift: system.columns multi-shard reflection expanded dynamic catalog to 280 features.
In-place partial selection (select_nth_unstable_by) shed 80 shadow columns. All 200 core signals restored with 0 B heap reallocations.
